method: Instance-mask RLE decoded in C order using the source convert.py convention. Bounds are compared against every volume face. Dense-cell semantic classes 1-6 are unioned and checked as connected components; this cannot separate touching cells.
conclusion: No platelet-sized fully interior instance in the 24/50-slice instance-label volumes. Dense-cell test semantic foreground is one component touching the z boundaries; no unambiguous complete cell instance can be extracted directly from those labels.
